source.scope: Read-only acquisition preparation; no calibration or historical pipeline adoption.

scope: Research-only complete five-page instrument overview, label and publisher-fixity assessment; no production adoption.

page1: PDS4 overview adapted from PDS3 instrument catalogue with light edits; source papers and mission website not a historical processing log.

Both raw and calibrated pixels are DN. Calibrated values require scene-dependent header/label divisors for radiance, not automatically visible RGB. Optically active1024/256 format excludes ancillary storage columns. Hal Weaver/APL PI attribution distinct authorship.
page2: Panchromatic with no colour filters; JHUAPL and SSG design/fabrication credits. Scientific objectives are mission objectives, not complete Elara coverage/calibration. In-flight performance through2019 cited to Weaver2020, not independently reproduced.
page3: Late2016 no-known-dead/hot-pixel prose explains all-zero calibration maps historically; not exhaustive present-day detector condition. Warm pixels handled in flat field per publisher, not independently executed for Elara.
Optical stray-light design simulation description is not validated current pointing/PSF/scene calibration.
page4: Table identifies0x630 as side1,1x1,lossless. Retained Elara pair has0x630 in filenames/headers; this is document/metadata agreement, not independent decoder execution or target identification.

First34 twelve-bit image samples contain51-byte engineering header, not scene brightness; displayed-corner description depends on left-to-right/bottom-to-top convention, not adopted current image registration.
Additional first40pixels of first8rows warning is explicitly for lossy0x632/635/638/63B, not the table0x630 category. Do not apply expanded masking to Elara merely from this warning.

Overview says raw has no QUALITY_MAP flags and additional lossy-region flags began with PlutoP2 late2016; this does not reconcile conflicting retained PDS3/PDS4 bit definitions or historical Elara processing.
page5: Scene-spectrum-dependent divisors and units are in Level2 absolute-calibration header section; references ICD9.3.1.4. Do not adopt Pluto or stellar divisors for unknown Elara spectrum.
ReferenceLID nh_documents:lorri:lorri_ssr agrees actual archived document, unlike retained raw/calibrated label Ralph-namespace reference. No identifier repair or cause inference.
Conard correctly spelled in reference versus Conrad in body prose retained as source spelling discrepancy, not a second contributor.

limits: No masking, timing correction, radiometric conversion, registered orientation, figure embedding or production change.
Current document publication/migration and historical calibration dates remain separate from2007 observations; label audit is recorded separately.
All earlier quality-definition, histogram, WINDOWH0, target/PSF and physical-registration limits remain.
